title: cache/cis/v1
description: A CIS dataset version the authority's subscriber verified and cached, announced on cis.v1.<dataset> (JetStream CIS, 30 d; docs/PLAN.md §6) in the 04 §2 envelope so detect re-reads proj_restrictions at once (LESSONS Z-12) and picture-ws shows the version. Internal to this system (NATS never crosses a system, M30); owned by uspace-authority (WP-6). The dataset's content is not carried: it is in cis_cache and, for restrictions, in proj_restrictions.

feature_count.description: Features of an ED-318 dataset, USSPs of the list.

fetched_at.description: When this system read the version (its clock).
